notes: §2002:15.41.2 AR1 'Argument-1 shall be of class alphanumeric or national and shall be 8 character positions in length.' with §2002:8.5.2.1: at --std 2002 FUNCTION LOCALE-DATE(D FR) over D PIC A(8) VALUE '20260819' compiles (COBOL1627 before kb/Work PB5615) and formats the date 19/08/2026 in fr-FR (DESIGN-locale-facility DETERMINATION L10). IntrinsicArgumentRules.Violation takes the edition: a position whose class set holds alphanumeric admits class alphabetic when EditionInfo.AlphabeticIsAlphanumeric. From 2014 the argument is refused (§2014:E.2): pb5615-locale-date-alphabetic-argument-refused.
